title: Execution-Grounded Credit Assignment (EGCA) Schema
description: Schema for localized token-level advantage attribution and trace divergence mapping in Phase 3

divergence_step.description: Earliest sequence term index where candidate output diverged from target

total_advantage.description: Conserved total group-relative advantage sum across sequence

advantage_vector.description: Per-token advantage weights a_i,t where downstream tokens t > max T_k* are masked to 0.0

coverage_mask.description: Runtime basic block execution coverage flags per token position
